values.summary: Implemented bounded HTML Observatory Runtime v3 launch/start-stop-restart integration and repaired exact-review findings: live mode now distinguishes real Runtime API data from retained mirror evidence, the live validator proves post-restart CSMctl start output is current, CSMctl separates Observatory document root from launch working directory, and retained proof logs were refreshed after the repair.
actual_changes: CSMctl static Observatory launch now has an explicit ADL_CSM_OBSERVATORY_LAUNCH_WORKING_DIR so the configured document root remains Apache-simple while launchd cwd access is not conflated with the served HTML path.
HTML Observatory visible chrome now renders Live Runtime API for live Runtime v3 mode and reserves retained/published mirror language for retained evidence paths.
The #340 validator captures post-restart CSMctl start output and fails closed if the restarted command reports a stale Observatory URL or stale Runtime API base.
Retained evidence logs under .csdlc/evidence/340 were refreshed after the second review finding instead of relying on stale pre-repair live output.
Focused HTML and Runtime API/WSS tests pin the live-label, exact HTTP 200, CSMctl root/runtime-base, launch working directory, and post-restart URL assertion contracts.
The work remains limited to #340 HTML Observatory Runtime restart/reconnect integration and excludes Unity, AWS/public hosting, provider credentials, #341, #343, #84, #122, and #251.
